keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «도시의 물 기계가 고장 났는데 고칠 사람이 없었다(문제)» 와 «많은 사람이 작은 일을 하면 큰 것을 지킬 수 있다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the city's water machine was broken, and the workers were too busy to fix it) and the lesson (when many people do a small thing, they can save something big). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Leo, the gardener robot, the families
The last tree on Mars had no water and was dying.
Every family saved one cup of water each day for the tree.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

the flat green parts of a tree or plant
someone who takes care of plants and gardens

qs.q: Why were the tree's leaves turning brown?
qs.qko: 나무의 잎은 왜 갈색으로 변하고 있었나요?
opts: The water machine was broken, so the tree got no water.
The gardener robot cut the leaves.
evs: The city's water machine was broken, and the workers were too busy to fix it.
In the year 2150, Leo lived in a glass city on Mars.
At first, only a few people came.
It was the last tree on Mars.
why: 도시의 물 기계가 고장 나서 나무가 물을 받지 못했어요. 정원사 로봇이 잎을 잘랐다는 말은 없어요.
The city's water machine was broken, so the tree got no water. The robot did not cut the leaves.

qs.q: The text says, "more and more people lined up with their cups." What does lined up mean?
qs.qko: "more and more people lined up with their cups."라고 나와요. lined up은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: stood in a row, waiting to give water
evs: One morning, Leo saw that its leaves were turning brown.
He asked every family to save one cup of water from their drinks each day.
On the third day, the leaves turned green again, and a tiny flower opened.
Everything was metal and plastic, except one small apple tree in the park.
why: 레오가 가족마다 물 한 컵씩 모아 달라고 했어요. 사람들이 컵을 들고 차례로 줄을 서서 물을 주러 왔다는 뜻이에요.
Leo asked every family to save a cup of water. So people stood in a row with their cups, waiting to give water.

qs.q: How do we know Leo's plan worked?
qs.qko: 레오의 계획이 성공했다는 것을 어떻게 알 수 있나요?
opts: More and more people brought water, and the leaves turned green again.
The workers fixed the water machine first.
Leo planted a new tree in the park.
evs: Then more and more people lined up with their cups.
The city's water machine was broken, and the workers were too busy to fix it.
On the third day, the leaves turned green again, and a tiny flower opened.
why: 점점 더 많은 사람이 컵을 들고 왔고, 셋째 날에 잎이 다시 초록색이 되었어요. 두 문장을 이으면 계획이 성공했다는 것을 알 수 있어요.
More and more people came with their cups, and on the third day the leaves turned green again. Together, these clues show the plan worked.

ends: Leo and his friends plant new trees all over Mars.
레오와 친구들이 화성 곳곳에 새 나무를 심어요.
The apple tree grows its first red apple.

write.src: “If <u>everyone saves a little water</u>, we can <u>save the last tree</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «어떤 상황 + 그때 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write a situation and what we can do then in English.

chips.a: everyone picks up one piece of trash
chips.label: trash

chips.a: each of us brings one book
chips.label: books

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을, «we can» 뒤에는 동사를 바로 쓰세요. (예: If we help each other, we can finish fast)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what. After «we can», write a verb. (e.g. If we help each other, we can finish fast)

img.cover: Inside a glass dome city on red Mars, a boy with short orange hair in a silver jumpsuit with a blue collar pours a cup of water onto a small apple tree with brown and green leaves, while a long line of smiling families holds cups behind him and a tall thin green gardener robot with a watering can arm watches from the side.

scenes.1: In a metal park under a glass dome on Mars, a boy with short orange hair in a silver jumpsuit with a blue collar gently touches the dry brown leaves of a small apple tree with a sad face, while a tall thin green gardener robot with a watering can arm stands next to a broken water machine that puffs gray steam.
scenes.3: In the park under the glass dome on Mars, the small apple tree is green again with one tiny white flower, while a boy with short orange hair in a silver jumpsuit with a blue collar cheers with both arms up, families clap, and a tall thin green gardener robot with a watering can arm waves its watering can arm.

alt.1: Leo looks sadly at the dry brown leaves.
alt.3: The tree is green again with a tiny flower.
alt.cover: Leo pours water on the last tree on Mars.
